messages:
vikram: quick question — our endpoints currently return mixed statuses for auth failures (401/403/404). want a single contract we can document and have SDKs rely on. any strong opinions?
jess: propose: missing or malformed Authorization header -> 401 + WWW-Authenticate. invalid key (not in DB) -> 401. revoked/disabled key -> 403. insufficient scope -> 403. keep 404 only for resource-not-found (e.g. org doesn't exist).
maria-ops: +1. operationally we need X-RW-Correlation on every error and logs to capture masked key + correlation id. also suggest a rotate grace window (15m) where new key works and old key returns 403 with code=key_revoked during rollout.
sam-engineer: small nuance: some legacy clients treat 404 as an auth failure (to hide existence). if we flip behavior we should update SDK to normalize 401/403/404 -> AuthError to maintain backward compat.
vikram: good call. decision draft:
- missing header or bad token format -> 401, body {"error":"auth_missing","code":"auth_missing"}
- token not found -> 401, {"error":"auth_invalid","code":"auth_invalid"}
- token revoked/disabled -> 403, {"error":"auth_revoked","code":"auth_revoked"} (no extra details)
- insufficient scope/org mismatch -> 403, {"error":"forbidden","code":"insufficient_scope","hint":"request with org-scoped key"}
- resource not found -> 404 (no auth leak)

include headers: X-RW-Correlation, Retry-After (for rate-limit), X-RateLimit-Remaining.
jess: can we standardize error envelope? sample:
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
WWW-Authenticate: Redwood realm="api"
X-RW-Correlation: abc123

{
  "error": "unauthorized",
  "code": "auth_missing",
  "message": "Authorization header required",
  "docs": "https://docs.redwood.ai/api/auth#errors"
}
```
maria-ops: security note: don't echo user-supplied token or say "key 123 exists". security-bot: automated check -> policy ai:auth-01 requires no existence leaks in body, ok with above mapping.
security-bot: policy check: PASS (no body fields reveal existence), advise short TTL for rotate grace (<=15m) and audit log event for each revoke.
sam-engineer: i'll add tests in sdk: treat 401/403/404 as AuthError for now; add a feature-flagged stricter mapping in client 2.x. also add unit tests around WWW-Authenticate header presence and JSON code fields.
jess: i'll update OpenAPI and the internal API contract doc, include example responses and the migration notes. ping @vikram for PR review when ready.
vikram: thanks. operational plan: deploy router change behind feature flag, canary = 5% orgs, monitor spikes in 401 dashboards and support tickets. if big errors, roll back flag.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: canary rollout of auth-status-mapping v2 at 2026-03-17T14:00:00Z to cluster canary-1 (CI build 2026.3.17-842).
maria-ops: i'll watch logs and post any client regression. also will add a dashboard with breakdown 401 vs 403 vs 404 + top client ids.
vikram: action items: jess -> PR for spec + OpenAPI, sam -> SDK changes + tests, maria-ops -> dashboards + alert. target: land changes next week and do canary. thanks all :)
